offering_description.value: Operates an online automotive marketplace where car dealers list new and used vehicles and buy advertising and software tools to attract shoppers. It sells mainly to franchised and independent auto dealers and to car manufacturers, delivering the service through subscriptions, digital advertising and dealer software.

primary_products.value: vehicle listings; dealer websites; digital retailing software

primary_services.value: digital advertising; lead generation; dealer marketing services

customer_segment.value: B2B: franchised and independent car dealers, automotive manufacturers and their advertising programs

end_markets.value: automotive retail; automotive manufacturing; digital advertising

revenue_model.value: subscription: dealers pay recurring fees for listings and software; advertising: manufacturers and dealers pay for promotional placements on the marketplace

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: runs an online marketplace and dealer software, sold to car dealers; service provider: provides marketing and lead generation services to dealers and manufacturers

geography_served.value: US national: serves dealers and shoppers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: vehicle listings, dealer software and automotive advertising, sharing dealer and shopper customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling subscriptions and advertising to dealers and manufacturers; online: consumer-facing website and app where shoppers browse listings

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer data privacy and advertising rules, including FTC and state rules on auto dealer advertising

notes: Offerings and revenue mix may have changed since my knowledge was last updated; verify the current business lines.
